import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=None)

header_idx = 3
headers = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
data = df_raw.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
data.columns = headers

# Filter out rows where Invoice ID is NaN or starts with month label or SUBTOTAL or GRAND TOTAL
def is_valid_invoice(inv):
    if pd.isna(inv):
        return False
    inv_str = str(inv).strip()
    # Exclude month labels, subtotals, grand total
    if inv_str in ['APRIL 2025','MAY 2025','JUNE 2025']:
        return False
    if inv_str.startswith('SUBTOTAL'):
        return False
    if inv_str.startswith('GRAND TOTAL'):
        return False
    # Invoice IDs start with SEVA-
    if not inv_str.startswith('SEVA-'):
        return False
    return True

valid_mask = data['Invoice ID'].apply(is_valid_invoice)
df_valid = data[valid_mask].copy()
print("Valid rows:", len(df_valid))
print(df_valid.head())

# Convert Quantity and Unit Rate to numeric
df_valid['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df_valid['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
df_valid['Unit Rate (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_valid['Unit Rate (INR)'], errors='coerce')
# Compute Line Amount
df_valid['Line Amount'] = df_valid['Quantity'] * df_valid['Unit Rate (INR)']

# Check for missing
print(df_valid[['Invoice ID','Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)','Line Amount','District']].head(20))
print("Any NaNs?", df_valid[['Quantity','Unit Rate (INR)','District']].isna().sum())

def is_valid_invoice(inv):

        return False

    if inv_str in ['APRIL 2025','MAY 2025','JUNE 2025']:
        return False

        return False
    if inv_str.startswith('GRAND TOTAL'):
